decoded.meaning: FWD{ op=WRITE, dst=<path label 0:1>/sensor, src=/reply-ep, VALUE u32=5 } - the ALLOW half of the pair RFC-0027 8.2 mandates: the labelled spelling of an operation whose string twin spells dst=/net/uplink/b/sensor.
decoded.note: Against a node where the label's slot is live and the dereferenced vertex's :acl grants the caller WRITE, this frame and its string twin forward the SAME residual, byte for byte. A by-construction argument is not a test - RFC-0014 shipped two silent misroutes because no test used the production wiring - so the claim is bound by core/tests/path_label_forward_test.cpp.
